reviews.text: 通关一周目，解锁额外五个角色，没战斗画面，消磨时间可以，挺简单的

[h1]🎮 A Surprisingly Deep Roguelite Tower Defense Experience 🎮[/h1] 🎨 What happens when you pick up a mysterious gem and suddenly gain the power to copy the Demon King's abilities? That's the premise of [b]拾取宝石后意外觉醒了复制魔王力量的逆天技能[/b] - a mouthful of a title that translates to "[i][b]After Picking Up a Gem, I Accidentally Awakened the Heaven-Defying Skill to Copy the Demon King's Power[/b][/i]" for English speakers. Yes, it's a very long name straight out of the light novel era, but don't let that discourage you! ⚖️ 📰 Here's something worth noting - the game [b]was available for FREE[/b] from March 9 to June 1, 2026 as part of a generous 84-day promotional campaign! During that period, players could claim it directly on this Steam store page at no cost. For those interested in additional game keys and bonuses from the same developer, the official promotion page at [url=http://zeros.group/free]zeros.group/free[/url] offered extra rewards. You can check the original announcement details at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4138970/view/534377017995428020]Steam News Post[/url]. If you're reading this after June 2026, the game may now be priced normally - but it's still worth checking if it's on sale! 🎁 🎮 The gameplay puts you in control of a nine-tailed fox spirit navigating through a misty forest filled with puzzles, traps, and formidable enemies. The core mechanic revolves around copying enemy attack power - a unique twist that keeps combat fresh and strategic. Every area choice could mean life or death, adding genuine tension to each run. The tower defense-like elements combined with roguelite randomness create an engaging loop that had me coming back for "just one more run" repeatedly! 🔄 📊 This is the 5th game from developer Zeros, and you can explore their full catalog at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42307483]Zeros Game Studio Curator Page[/url]. The studio has been building a reputation for strategy RPG games filled with childhood nostalgia, and this title continues that tradition. For those interested in developer updates and community content, their [url=https://space.bilibili.com/111259612]Bilibili Channel[/url] offers additional behind-the-scenes material (though it's in Chinese). 🎬 [h2]✅ What Works Well[/h2] [list] [*]✅ Unique copy-enemy-power mechanic that adds strategic depth to combat. [*]✅ Charming nine-tailed fox protagonist with transformation abilities. [*]✅ Perfect blend of tower defense and roguelite elements. [*]✅ Each run feels different thanks to random skill and equipment upgrades. [*]✅ Strategic decision-making in area selection creates meaningful choices. [*]✅ Solid gameplay loop that keeps you engaged run after run. [/list] [h2]❌ What Could Be Better[/h2] [list] [*]❌ Very long Chinese title may be difficult for international players to remember. [*]❌ Language barrier - currently only supports Simplified Chinese. [*]❌ Limited information available in English for non-Chinese speakers. [*]❌ New release means fewer community guides and resources available. [*]❌ Developer's social media presence is primarily on Chinese platforms [/list] ⚖️ The game delivers a solid experience for fans of strategy roguelites. The core gameplay loop is satisfying, and the unique copying mechanic sets it apart from similar titles in the genre. However, the language limitation is a significant barrier for international players who don't read Chinese. The 84-day free promotion was a fantastic opportunity to try it risk-free, but even at full price, it offers decent value for the right audience. 🌏 🔗 For those who can navigate the language barrier or are willing to use translation tools, this is [b]Recommended[/b] if you enjoy roguelite strategy games. The gameplay mechanics are solid, the art style is appealing, and the progression system keeps you motivated. For English-only speakers, the experience may be limited, but the [b]Worth Your Time[/b] label still applies if you're curious about innovative roguelite mechanics or support indie developers from China. 📢 [h2]🎯 Final Verdict[/h2] 📊 Whether you claimed this during the free promotional period (March - June 2026) or are considering purchasing it afterward, [b]拾取宝石后意外觉醒了复制魔王力量的逆天技能[/b] offers a unique take on the roguelite tower defense genre. The free promotion was one of the more generous campaigns seen in 2026, giving players 84 days to claim and keep the game forever. 🎮 ⚖️ If you understand Chinese or don't mind using translation assistance, [b]Recommended[/b] - the gameplay is worth experiencing! For those who missed the free window, check the current price and wait for a sale if needed. Either way, this is a solid addition to any roguelite fan's library. Just don't expect a fully localized experience just yet. 🌟

Game has much more depth and has been more enjoyable than I expected. Definitely recommend checking the game out. It is similar to Magic Tower game style except with additional roguelike mechanics including permanent upgrades ranging from increased base stats, curse removal, more abilities to choose from when managing enemies, extra gold chests on stages with gear/abilities/etc, and random chance for game-changing gear each run. Every run is a bit different from the previous one adding to replayability. There are a variety of characters the player can transform into each with their own unique abilities and playstyle. The battle outcome for every enemy on the map can be easily seen at a glace, making it feel much more chill allowing players to casually go through the levels quickly. It is fun to see impossible enemies suddenly change to an easy win with the right ability or skill which can be freely swapped mid-run. In addition, to permanent upgrades, there is also the option to save up on the soul currency to spend on temporary upgrades to try to invest in a specific run which can help for pushing to new areas. Unfortunately, there is no English translation yet, which makes it a bit more challenging having to figure out mechanics and item descriptions using imperfect translators.

作为一款主打策略与爽感结合的冒险游戏，《拾取宝石后意外觉醒了复制魔王力量的逆天技能》以独特的核心设定，打破了传统冒险游戏的战力局限，带来了兼具新鲜感与策略深度的游玩体验，全程沉浸感拉满。 游戏开篇简洁有力，玩家操控的角色在幽暗迷宫中探索时，意外拾取一枚神秘魔石，瞬间觉醒复制魔王与敌人力量的逆天技能，原本艰难的生存冒险，从此迎来反转。这一设定并非噱头，而是贯穿全程的核心玩法，玩家可在战斗中实时复制敌人的攻击力与专属技能，将对手的优势转化为自身战力，实现以弱胜强的逆转，“以彼之道还施彼身”的爽感直击人心。 游戏采用像素风格搭配格子探索模式，关卡随机生成陷阱、宝箱与NPC，每一局游玩都有不同体验，有效避免了重复游玩的枯燥感。玩家可搭配复制的技能与随机解锁的装备，构建专属战斗流派，兼顾路径规划与即时战斗决策，既考验策略布局，又能享受即时战斗的快感。 剧情围绕魔石秘密与角色身世展开，简洁有力且层层递进，随着玩家不断复制更强的力量，逐步揭开魔王压制与族群尘封的真相，让探索更具目的性。战斗节奏紧凑，技能特效克制不浮夸，搭配贴合场景的音效，进一步提升了冒险的沉浸感。 这款游戏以创新的复制技能为核心，将策略性与爽感完美融合，随机化玩法保证了长期游玩的趣味性，适合喜欢冒险与策略类游戏的玩家。无需复杂操作，就能体验到逆天技能带来的乐趣，是一款能让人快速沉浸、越玩越上头的佳作。 [table][td][b]关注我们 [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/30253125]甄游组[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34433893]第一印象[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40602490]免费游戏[/url][/td][/table]

拾取宝石后意外觉醒了复制魔王力量的逆天技能 is a roguelite strategy dungeon crawler developed and published by zeros. The game immediately draws attention because of its unusually long and descriptive title, which loosely translates to “After Picking Up a Gem, I Accidentally Awakened an Overpowered Skill That Copies the Demon King’s Power.” Beneath the playful name lies a small but cleverly designed indie game that combines classic “Magic Tower”–style grid exploration with roguelite progression and a unique combat mechanic built around copying enemy abilities. The overall experience emphasizes strategic thinking, careful resource management, and repeated runs through randomized dungeon scenarios. The story centers on a mysterious fox-spirit protagonist who unexpectedly gains supernatural powers after discovering a magical gemstone hidden within a dangerous forest labyrinth. This gem awakens an extraordinary ability that allows the hero to replicate the attack strength and powers of enemies encountered during the adventure. Although the narrative itself is relatively light and unfolds gradually through brief hints and environmental clues, it suggests a deeper conflict involving the origins of the gem, the fate of the fox clan, and the mysterious forces lurking within the maze-like wilderness. Rather than delivering a heavily scripted narrative, the game focuses on letting players uncover fragments of lore as they progress through increasingly difficult dungeon runs. Gameplay is structured around a tile-based dungeon system reminiscent of classic puzzle RPGs. Movement occurs across a grid where each step carries strategic significance. Every room or corridor may contain enemies, items, or branching paths that influence the player’s survival. Unlike fast-paced action games, the experience is deliberate and tactical, encouraging players to think several steps ahead before committing to battles or exploring new areas. Choosing which enemies to confront and when to retreat becomes a crucial element of the game’s strategy. The most distinctive feature of the game is its power-copying mechanic. Instead of relying solely on traditional weapons or stat upgrades, players gain strength by absorbing aspects of their enemies’ abilities. This system transforms combat into a strategic opportunity rather than just a challenge to overcome. Certain enemies possess powerful abilities that can be copied and used later, meaning players must carefully evaluate which foes are worth confronting in order to gain their skills. The ability to replicate enemy power introduces a dynamic layer of strategy that keeps the gameplay fresh across multiple runs. In addition to the copying mechanic, the game includes a large variety of randomized upgrades that appear during each expedition. These upgrades can enhance attack strength, grant special abilities, improve survivability, or introduce entirely new combat mechanics. Because these upgrades appear in different combinations each time the player starts a new run, the game constantly encourages experimentation with different character builds. Some runs may favor aggressive strategies focused on high damage output, while others may reward defensive or control-oriented approaches. Exploration takes place within a fog-covered forest labyrinth that gradually expands as the player ventures deeper into the dungeon. The maze-like level design reinforces the game’s puzzle-like nature, as every decision affects the player’s ability to survive the journey. Players must manage limited resources while navigating dangerous enemies and searching for valuable items. Poor decisions can quickly lead to defeat, forcing the player to restart and attempt a new strategy during the next run. Visually, the game embraces a retro pixel-art aesthetic that echoes the appearance of older dungeon RPGs. Character sprites and environments are relatively simple but clearly designed, ensuring that players can easily interpret enemy positions, paths, and interactive objects. The fog-shrouded forest setting adds an element of mystery to the exploration, even though the graphics remain intentionally minimalistic. The visual simplicity helps keep the focus on the strategic gameplay rather than on complex graphical effects. The audio design follows a similarly restrained approach. Background music consists of atmospheric tracks that complement the mysterious tone of the labyrinth. Sound effects accompany combat actions, skill activations, and item pickups, providing feedback during gameplay. While the audio elements are modest, they contribute to the game’s immersive atmosphere and reinforce the sense of cautious exploration that defines the experience. One notable aspect of the game is its accessibility. The title launched as a free-to-play project on Steam, making it easy for players to try without financial commitment. Its low system requirements and compact file size further expand its accessibility, allowing it to run on a wide range of hardware configurations. For players interested in experimental indie projects or retro-inspired dungeon games, this accessibility makes it an easy title to explore. Despite its creativity, the game does have certain limitations. The visual presentation is intentionally simple, which may not appeal to players expecting more detailed environments or modern graphical effects. The dungeon layouts, while randomized, can occasionally feel repetitive after long play sessions. Additionally, the game’s interface and language support are primarily oriented toward Chinese players, which may create a barrier for international audiences unfamiliar with the language. Nevertheless, the underlying gameplay mechanics provide surprising depth for such a small project. The combination of grid-based strategy, roguelite progression, and the innovative power-copying system creates a gameplay loop that encourages experimentation and repeated attempts. Each run feels like a puzzle where players must adapt their strategy to the abilities and enemies encountered along the way. Overall, 拾取宝石后意外觉醒了复制魔王力量的逆天技能 is a creative indie roguelite that demonstrates how simple mechanics can produce engaging strategic gameplay. While its minimalist presentation and small scope prevent it from feeling like a large-scale RPG, the inventive combat system and replayable dungeon structure make it a memorable experience within the niche of retro dungeon crawlers. Players who enjoy grid-based strategy games and roguelite experimentation will likely find the game surprisingly compelling despite its modest appearance. Rating: 7/10

全是BUG，而且只有一点点游戏内容，很多都是老魔塔底子随便搬一下就算新游戏了。 金币套有问题，买了之后点攻击防御会减，点防御攻击会减，大无语。 萝卜币没有开放，而且选了之后会导致药水捡取失效，直接凉凉。 开局如果选了老玩家选项，后期就没法重置，无法挑战1周目魔王，成就就没了。 进图等级+2那个选了和没有没区别，属性也要先去其他图块才会生效。 一共就几百只怪，塔罗牌顶死两张，杀敌加攻速那个天赋也是无效的，很多技能是假的。 选妖狐魅惑就没箱子，到后期选项少好多，强制用狐狸技能来回打好多次。

喜欢领赛博鸡蛋的推荐，奔着魔塔游戏来的不推荐。这款比蓝海塔还蓝的"魔塔"游戏就像加了橙汁的美式中餐一样让人忍不住怀疑自己的游戏品味。 游戏共四张地图，半小时体量，却又"创意性地"引入了 Rougulite 元素。每局游戏宝石、敌人的位置会刷新，结算的素材可以局外升级属性。这种设计令我很不解，魔塔本就是一种追求数值精细策划和SL探寻最优解的解谜向游戏，引入肉鸽机制来限制进度多少有点没活了硬水游戏时长的嫌疑，我想玩肉鸽为什么要选魔塔？更别提数值平衡是一点不做的，局外点够了就能乱杀，说是拆塔实际游戏体验堪比吃豆人，肯下功夫的地方是一点不做，游戏内容全是免费素材和AI图，有这闲工夫不如花点小钱吃顿好的。 免费游戏不是它的挡箭牌，相反作者应该为我浪费的四小时做出相应赔偿。
挺好玩的，可惜加了RPG的人物特性后自由度还是略微欠缺。挖你起来有点重复和僵硬。 免费但是值得玩一下。

不错的魔塔类游戏，但感觉有点像半成品，没有形成完备的玩法体系，地图过于单一，重复性极高，后期让人厌烦，局外成长有限。 狐妖属于轮椅角色可以无脑冲撞，但其他角色经常卡在3区，平衡性有待提升。 最后补充一个小bug：升级后的技能装备选择，按esc可以重新选择，不会消耗次数，以此可以刷出来自己需要的技能或者装备。

游戏体验7/10分，q版魔塔游戏，流畅很短只有4层，剧情通关大约4~5小时，主要是了解数值花了点时间，后面解开能力和熟悉打法之后一局大概1小时左右能结束，结尾有一些个人打法懒b可以直接参考。 游戏其实做得比较粗糙，感觉像试玩版。虽然装备技能看上去很多，也有5个可玩角色，但是了解机制之后会发现其实这游戏压根不需要什么流派构筑的，基本无脑花金币买防御就能通关；而且因为流程实在是太短了，很多装备技能又要杀怪叠层数，就感觉挺鸡肋的，一些道具也标着无尽模式估计本来是给无尽模式用的，但是压根没有。不过考虑到是免费游戏，当4399小游戏打发时间也不错。 个人打法 开局随便打就行，一开始是剧情模式，通关之后会发现打败的是假魔王然后进入自由模式，这里才是真正的开始 自由模式前两把也是随便打打存灵魂，因为主角的诅咒debuff扣的属性太多了大概率最后的魔王是打不过的。优先解除扣20%防御的诅咒，主角可以复制敌人攻击力，后面把资源堆防御基本可以无伤通关，装备都挺鸡肋的别选扣属性的就行，其他角色攻防都要升所以可以拿一把均衡之剑，能省点金币升攻击，被动可以选毒液防御、坚固的防御、粘稠血液，最后省点蓝就行，能无伤的平A，技能多切几次看哪个战损小用哪个，最后那个升级选技能其实能sl的，按返回再选重新选择就能刷新技能
啥玩意，白天点开，开始玩，再一抬头半夜两点了

作为我第一款主线通关的魔塔游戏来说，拾取宝石还是比较良心的，在打通第一次剧情[spoiler]打死了魔王，但如死[/spoiler]之后可以堆初始数值和降低debuff，还能魅惑别的角色实现类似副职业一样的功能，雪球滚起来之后后面基本就无脑扫，打起来很爽。 目前魅惑炼金术师全诅咒解锁+魅惑满级+初始数值拉满，最后还差个第五区的箱子回头再打了，这游戏美中不足的一点就是炼金术师太强（褒义）而其他角色相对没那么无脑，导致其他角色的流程相对比较磨蹭； 炼金术师手搓装备的技能一开基本就到处随便乱秒，而炼金术师的宝石升级的技能太贵，说是按区域增加技能下的素材产出，但是我都到最后一两个区域了有那个功夫我直接搓装备就飞过去了，而且搓出3级宝石之后素材也所剩无几搓不出几个攻防宝石，总结是很鸡肋的技能。 另外有几个技能说是可以跳过一格穿墙，但是我各种试好像从来没触发过，也不知道是不是bug。 总结来说就是玩过魅惑炼金术师流之后其他流派的速度就觉得慢的太离谱了，希望加强其他的职业，或者平衡数值让玩法更加多样化。
玩了一会儿，感觉还不错，看后续吧

非常有策略性的一款小游戏最近手机上很火的爬塔游戏很像游戏难度略微偏大数值计算稍微有点复杂这款游戏是免费的喜欢这个类型的还是推荐值得玩一下的游戏重点在于策略没有恶心的回合制画面风格是2 d像素的类型总的来说还是很值得推荐的
快捷移动没有，地图显示也是一坨，走错一步撤销也没有。内容还算丰富，但体验太差了远远不如h5魔塔

虽然这游戏装备看上去很多，但实际上的套路其实并不多，如果只是为了通关的话，装备基本上带正义镰刀跟锤子，然后buff优先选攻守兼备还有免疫吸血中毒这种buff，如果看到有加血瓶回血量的被动也要优先拿到，妖狐的话只要把诅咒debuff全消然后拿到推魔防的被动后一路无脑加防御就行了，因为性能相比幻化角色过于强大基本玩几把就随便通关了，魅惑人物更是纯无双的爽游。虽然这游戏深度一般但是只是单纯想找个休闲小游戏的话还是可以下下来玩几把的，如果是魔塔游戏的骨灰级玩家的话可能对这表面肉鸽的装备池不怎么感兴趣吧。
啊？刷新bug修复了啊，那就没得玩常了……

刚开始玩挺有意思，有种怀念的感觉，但是多玩几次就挺无聊了。 随机的地方很神秘，第一张图可能随机都是弱怪，全图无伤扫空吃满到下一关，也可能给你随机出来一堆强怪，狠狠吃战损捂伤通关，甚至怪物位置随机，可能出现重要道具（指技能宝箱）的路居然能不打怪直接拿，也可能出现全都是第二关的怪给它围起来。 而且目前来看游戏也就四关，黄骷髅兵，骷髅王，假魔王，魔王，其实可玩性也就那样了。 算上怀旧的情怀分，10分给个7分都比较勉强了。
免费游戏值得一个好评。很多也是往昔的回忆
